nodes.name: Personnel Data Entry
nodes.plain_english: HR staff fill in a multi-page form with the employee's personal info, current role, and the position they are being considered for.

nodes.name: Work Evaluation & Scoring
nodes.plain_english: Captures past achievements, evaluation scores, and structured evaluation grid rows for each promotion candidate.

nodes.name: Summary Dashboard
nodes.plain_english: Shows charts with total candidates, pass/fail counts, and breakdowns by position level.

nodes.name: Records List & Search
nodes.plain_english: A searchable table where HR staff browse, filter, edit, or delete promotion records.

nodes.name: Records CRUD API
nodes.plain_english: Server-side endpoints that create, read, update, and delete promotion records after validating required Thai fields.

nodes.name: PDF Attachment API
nodes.plain_english: Handles uploading, storing, previewing, and downloading PDF documents linked to each promotion record.

nodes.name: CSV Export API
nodes.plain_english: Streams all promotion records as a CSV file so HR staff can open them in Excel.

nodes.name: Desktop Launcher
nodes.plain_english: Starts Flask in a background thread and opens the app as a native Windows desktop window using pywebview.

nodes.name: Database & Migrations
nodes.plain_english: SQLite database storing all promotion records and attachment metadata, with automatic schema migration for legacy columns.

nodes.name: Google Fonts
nodes.plain_english: Loads the Sarabun Thai-language typeface for the UI.

nodes.name: Bootstrap CDN
nodes.plain_english: Delivers Bootstrap 5 CSS for responsive layout and UI components.

nodes.name: Font Awesome CDN
nodes.plain_english: Delivers icon glyphs used throughout the interface.

nodes.name: Chart.js CDN
nodes.plain_english: Renders bar and summary charts on the dashboard tab.

summary.headline: A Thai government HR tool where staff record employee promotion evaluations, attach PDF documents, and view pass/fail statistics on a dashboard.
